name: Four Seasons Hotel Seoul
positioning: Contemporary luxury hotel in Seoul's Gwanghwamun district, Four Seasons' first location in South Korea
best_for: Travelers who want a base in Gwanghwamun, steps from historic sites
Guests who want a Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant and cocktail bars on site
Guests who want a suite with a view of Gyeongbokgung Palace

facts.text: The hotel has 317 accommodations in total.
The hotel is at 97 Saemunan-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul.
The hotel is located in Gwanghwamun, steps from historic sites and neighbourhoods.
Gwanghwamun Station is a three-minute walk from the hotel.
More than 160 contemporary artworks are on display throughout the hotel.
Yu Yuan is the hotel's Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant.
Boccalino is the hotel's Italian restaurant.
The gym is open 24 hours a day.
The hotel is Four Seasons' first location in South Korea.

highlights.text: The Palace-View Executive Suite has an unobstructed, floor-to-ceiling panorama of Gyeongbokgung Palace from every room, including the bathroom.
Charles H. is a cocktail bar on the hotel's lower level.
H. Bar is an eight-seat enclave offering a course-style cocktail experience.
Akira Back serves Japanese cuisine with a Korean twist.
The Korean sauna features cold, warm and hot baths as well as wet and dry sauna rooms.

considerations.text: A fee applies for valet parking, excluding guests staying in suites or with promotional room packages that include complimentary valet parking services.
Incheon International Airport is approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes from the hotel by car.
The Kids for All Seasons Lounge is a paid program that operates on a reservation-only basis.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
